config.coupling: preserve original conditional away/home shares given non-draw; equal shares at zero original mass

exploratory_revision.reason: Zero-slope maps and development losses differing around1e-12 motivated the constant control and numerical tie rule; independent stress testing motivated optimizer status handling.
exploratory_revision.scope: Final algorithm still selects only on development data; experimental design was revised after an initial exploratory comparison, not preregistered.

limits: Historical2022/23–2024/25five-league cohort was reused by earlier studies; not prospective evidence or a new independent holdout.
Draw calibration is binary. Conditional home/away coupling is local, not a multiclass beta method or a joint calibration guarantee.
Both draw maps use fixed ridge1e-3 on nonnegative coefficients and an unpenalized intercept. These regularization and constraints differ from unconstrained Algorithm2 fitting.
The constant control uses the calibration-window draw frequency without an optimizer. All draw methods require both binary outcomes for comparability.

Explicit draw-method experiments treat developmentNLL differences<=1e-9 as numerical ties and use fixed simpler-method priority. Original three-map-only experiments retain exact-tie selection semantics.
The beta family includes identity before penalized fitting; ridge and finite samples do not guarantee an unchanged fitted identity or improved unseen predictions.
All maps share smaller prefix-only base fits with separate calibration suffixes. Do not attribute differences against full-development model fits solely to calibration.
Final holdout scores never select or replace the development-selected method. ECE is descriptive and bin-sensitive; no statistical superiority or coverage claim.
One seed and fixed configuration only. Earlier-kickoff history does not verify result arrival at real-time decision boundaries.
No new match data, main warehouse query/hash/copy, model package, production prediction or website publication. Research command defaults retain the original three maps.
Initial five-map holdout results were inspected before the constant baseline and tie policy were added. The final configuration is an exploratory revision, not a new untouched validation cohort.

references.local_adaptations: Fixed coefficient ridge, draw-vs-rest target, constant-frequency control, conditional non-draw coupling, chronological windows and explicit numerical selection tie band.
references.selected_reading: Sections3.1–3.3, Algorithm2 and the constraints paragraph on physicalPDFpages4–6; Section4 selected validation protocol only.
